quote: Except as otherwise provided in this Chapter: No person shall stand or park a vehicle in a roadway other than parallel with the edge of the roadway headed in the direction of lawful traffic movement.

activation.condition: Responsible person stands or parks a vehicle in a roadway; actual activity and roadway must be source established

obligation.description: Resting vehicle is parallel with the identified roadway edge and headed in lawful traffic direction
obligation.source_clause: parallel with the edge of the roadway headed in the direction of lawful traffic movement

exceptions.source_clause: Except as otherwise provided in this Chapter
exceptions.description: Review applicable Chapter provisions and location-specific controls; no exception inferred from authored angle

timing.description: Judge during actual standing or parking, not the entry maneuver; no numeric duration or angular cutoff supplied

parameter_refs.name: requested_yaw_offset_deg
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: 0, 35 or 180 degrees relative to authored lawful flow

parameter_refs.name: observed_edge_angle_deg
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: saved unsigned original heading versus edge tangent

parameter_refs.name: observed_lawful_heading_deg
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: saved signed original heading versus lawful flow

parameter_refs.name: roadway_edge
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: one-way roadway with identified outside edge
